verdict.rationale: Browserbase's own docs describe webhooks that send an HTTP POST to an endpoint you own whenever a subscribed event happens. Endpoints can be registered from Settings or through the SDK, and each delivery carries a signature you can verify, so programmatic subscription is covered end to end. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration, and an enumerated catalog of subscribable event types.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks

citations.quote: Browserbase webhooks send an HTTP POST to an endpoint you own as soon as a subscribed event happens, so you don't have to poll the API for status changes.
You can manage endpoints from Settings as well as through the SDK. Both act on the same webhooks.
Verify the signature on every request and reject anything that fails.
